title: 484. Minimum Unique Word Abbreviation

examples.explanation: a4 keeps the leading a and skips four letters; blade starts with b so it cannot match.
1p3 is the shortest shorthand of apple avoided by all three dictionary words.
With no rivals, the whole word compresses to its length.

hints: An abbreviation matches a word when its letters line up and its numbers skip the right counts; leading zeros are illegal.
Only dictionary words with the same length as the target can collide.
Enumerate every abbreviation pattern by bitmask and keep the shortest one avoiding all rivals.
